name: The Hunt Begins
objective_summary: Kill 10 Plainstriders right outside Camp Narache.
wowhead_notes: Plainstriders are everywhere within 50 yards of the camp. They are neutral and die in 2-3 hits. 100% completion in 2 minutes.

name: A Simple Note (Class Starter)
objective_summary: Walk 15 yards to your class trainer in Camp Narache.
wowhead_notes: Instant free XP right inside the starter camp. Also unlocks your first spell/ability.

name: The Hunt Continues
objective_summary: Collect 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.
wowhead_notes: Cougars are located slightly south and east along the mesa foothills. Drop rate is roughly 80%. Very easy to bundle with Boars.

name: The Battleboars
objective_summary: Collect 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.
wowhead_notes: Battleboars roam in the same clearing as the Mountain Cougars. High drop rate (around 85%), excellent XP density when done together.

name: Attack on Camp Narache
objective_summary: Collect 10 Bristleback Belts from Bristleback invaders.
wowhead_notes: Bristleback camp to the south. Mobs are aggressive level 3-4 quillboars. Drop rate is ~75%. Quick pull loops.

name: Break Sharptusk!
objective_summary: Kill Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle and loot his head.
wowhead_notes: Deep inside the dirt mound hut at the south end of Red Cloud Mesa. Has 2 bodyguards; pull carefully or burst down. Huge XP chunk.

name: Rites of the Earthmother (Part 1)
objective_summary: Deliver Hawkwind's message to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
wowhead_notes: Transition quest. You walk down the path out of Red Cloud Mesa directly into Bloodhoof Village. Free XP on arrival.

name: Sharing the Land
objective_summary: Clear Palemane gnolls around Stonebull Lake.
wowhead_notes: Gnolls are just west of Bloodhoof Village along the lake shore. Dense spawns, fast respawns, 100% kill count.

name: Dwarven Digging
objective_summary: Break 5 Prospector Pickaxes at Bael'dun.
wowhead_notes: Bael'dun excavation site in western Mulgore. The mining tools are on the ground near the machines. Some aggressive dwarf mobs.

name: Dangers of the Windfury
objective_summary: Collect 8 Windfury Talons from harpies.
wowhead_notes: Harpies at the Windfury Ridge northeast of Bloodhoof. Drop rate is roughly 65-70%. Harpies flee at low HP, pull carefully.

name: Swoop Hunting
objective_summary: Collect 8 Swoop Gizzards.
wowhead_notes: Notorious bad drop rate! Swoops are sparse, wander high in the air, and have about a 20% gizzard drop rate. Players report killing 30+ birds to get 8 gizzards. Huge waste of time for speedrunners.

name: Mazzranache
objective_summary: Collect 4 Prairie Wolf Paws, 4 Cougar Claws, 4 Plainstrider Scales, and 1 Swoop Gizzard.
wowhead_notes: Absolute trap quest. Requires hunting 4 distinct animal species scattered across the entire zone. Prairie Wolf paws and Swoop gizzards have abysmal drop rates. Takes 25-35 minutes of random wandering.

name: The Demon-Scarred Cloak
objective_summary: Find and kill The Prowler (rare spawn mountain lion) and bring cloak to Bloodhoof.
wowhead_notes: The Prowler is a rare spawn that wanders an enormous patrol path across western Mulgore. 6-8 hour respawn timer. Finding him while leveling is pure lottery luck; never wait or search for him.

name: The Ravaged Caravan
objective_summary: Search the destroyed caravan north of Bloodhoof Village.
wowhead_notes: Just click the wrecked wagon crates. Directly on the path toward Thunder Bluff and Venture Co. Fast, zero combat needed.

name: Winterhoof Cleansing
objective_summary: Use the cleansing totem at the Winterhoof Water Well.
wowhead_notes: The well is just southeast of Bloodhoof Village. Surrounded by a few gnolls you can easily bypass. Click totem at well, done in 90 seconds.

name: Thunderhorn Totem
objective_summary: Collect 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Pelts around Thunderhorn Water Well.
wowhead_notes: Northwest of Bloodhoof. High density of Prairie Stalkers and Flatland Cougars. Drop rates are ~75%. Pairs great with Wildmane Cleansing.

name: Rite of Vision
objective_summary: Drink the Water of the Seers and follow the Spirit Wolf.
wowhead_notes: Drink the potion next to the cauldron, wait for wolf to spawn, follow him to the cave entrance just north of town. Auto-walks, zero combat, easy XP.

name: Rite of Wisdom
objective_summary: Travel to Red Rocks, touch the ancestral tombstone, and report to Cairne in Thunder Bluff.
wowhead_notes: Red Rocks is east of Bloodhoof. Click the stone marker, then head directly north up the elevator into Thunder Bluff to turn in to Cairne Bloodhoof. Essential milestone quest.

name: The Venture Co.
objective_summary: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and Supervisors at the mine.
wowhead_notes: Venture Co. mine is east of Thunder Bluff. Very high mob density outside the mine entrance. Super fast kill grinding.

name: Supervisor Fizsprocket
objective_summary: Enter the mine cavern, kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and take his clipboard.
wowhead_notes: Located deep at the bottom of the twisting Venture Co mine cavern. Fast respawning mobs inside narrow tunnels. If you die, it's a 4-minute corpse run from Bloodhoof graveyard. Moderate solo danger.

name: Preparing for the Journey
objective_summary: Collect 6 Earthroot and 6 Peacebloom herbs.
wowhead_notes: Herbs can be picked by herbalists or bought directly from vendors / auction house. Easy turn-in if you have them ready.

name: The Barrens Ountpost
objective_summary: Deliver report to Kargal Battlescar at the Crossroads in The Barrens.
wowhead_notes: Zone transition quest! Take the flight path from Thunder Bluff or run through the east pass into The Barrens. Delivers you straight to the Crossroads.

name: Crossroads Conscription
objective_summary: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads tower.
wowhead_notes: Instant dialogue turn-in inside Crossroads. Grabs flight path and sets your hearthstone here.

name: Plainstrider Menace
objective_summary: Collect 7 Fleeting Plainstrider Beaks.
wowhead_notes: Plainstriders roam right outside the north gate of Crossroads. Very high drop rate (~85%), low mob HP. Fast XP burst.

name: The Zhevra Hooves
objective_summary: Collect 4 Zhevra Hooves.
wowhead_notes: The most legendary meme drop rate in World of Warcraft history. 'Do Zhevras not have hooves?!' Drop rate is roughly 15-20%. Players routinely kill 25-30 Zhevras across a vast savanna. Speedrunners ALWAYS skip this.

name: The Raptor Horns
objective_summary: Collect 5 Intact Raptor Horns.
wowhead_notes: Another infamous drop rate trap. Raptors call for help when low health, inflicting stacking bleeds. Intact horn drop rate is around 18-20%. Skip for speedrunning.

name: Disrupt the Attacks
objective_summary: Kill 8 Razormane Water Seekers and 8 Thornweavers.
wowhead_notes: Quillboar camps north and west of Crossroads. Excellent mob density, predictable spawns, 100% kill credit without drop RNG.

name: The Forgotten Pools
objective_summary: Investigate the Forgotten Pools oasis northwest of Crossroads.
wowhead_notes: Just dive to the bottom of the oasis bubble pool. Click the glowing bubble vent. Takes 45 seconds once at the oasis. Fantastic speedrun pickup.

name: The Stagnant Oasis
objective_summary: Investigate the Stagnant Oasis southeast of Crossroads.
wowhead_notes: Same mechanic: swim to bottom of oasis pool and inspect fissure. Great when combined with Kolkar Centaur hunting.

name: Altered Beasts
objective_summary: Collect 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells from oasis turtles.
wowhead_notes: Turtles have high armor and shell shield, but drop rate is ~80%. Right along the banks of the oasis.

name: Harpy Raiders
objective_summary: Collect 8 Witchwing Feathers from northwest harpies.
wowhead_notes: Harpies at Dry Hills northwest corner. Good pack density, drop rate ~70%. Easy chain with Harpy Lieutenants.

name: Harpy Lieutenants
objective_summary: Kill 6 Witchwing Slayers and 6 Windcallers.
wowhead_notes: Higher up in the hills. Windcallers cast lightning bolt and silence; casters need to interrupt. Fast kills for hunters and rogues.

name: Serena Bloodfeather
objective_summary: Kill Serena Bloodfeather (boss) and retrieve her head.
wowhead_notes: Level 20 harpy leader surrounded by 2 elite bodyguards on a wooden platform at the summit. Extremely difficult for solo players at level 15-16. Usually requires a group or kiting tactics.

name: Centaur Bracers
objective_summary: Collect 15 Centaur Bracers from Kolkar centaurs.
wowhead_notes: Kolkar camps near Forgotten Pools. Every centaur drops 1-2 bracers. You finish in 10-12 kills. Excellent XP efficiency.

name: The Samophlange
objective_summary: Shut down control valves at the Sludge Fen oil rig in northern Barrens.
wowhead_notes: Sludge Fen engineering hub. Click 3 valves in sequence (Shutoff valve 1, 2, 3), fight off 1 mechanical guardian, loot the control manual. Big XP.

name: Escape from the Silverwing
objective_summary: Escort the wounded goblin prisoner past hostile pirate ambushes to safety.
wowhead_notes: Painfully slow escort quest. The NPC crawls at 50% walking speed, stops to speak every 30 yards, and 3 waves of pirates spawn. If another player walks near, they can pull extra mobs and kill him, forcing a 15-minute wait. Massive speedrun trap!

name: Fungus Rock
objective_summary: Loot 6 Spores from the Fungus Rock cavern near Lushwater Oasis.
wowhead_notes: Fungus spores grow on the cave walls and surrounding rocks. Spiders in the cave poison and web. Moderately fast if you stay outside the cave.

name: Tribes at War
objective_summary: Kill 6 Kolkar Invaders and 6 Kolkar Wranglers.
wowhead_notes: Straightforward combat quest in the mid-Barrens. High centaur spawn density, minimal running.

name: Verog the Dervish
objective_summary: Kill centaurs at the pavilion until Verog spawns, then kill Verog.
wowhead_notes: Wave summon event. Kill ~10 centaurs until a horn sounds and Verog spawns from a tent. He hits reasonably hard. High XP reward.

name: Hezrul Bloodmark
objective_summary: Assassinate Warlord Hezrul Bloodmark near Lushwater Oasis.
wowhead_notes: Level 21 elite centaur warlord flanked by 2 guards. For solo players under level 19, this is suicidal without high-level help or specific CC.

name: Southsea Freebooters
objective_summary: Kill 12 Southsea Brigands and Cutthroats south of Ratchet.
wowhead_notes: Pirate camps right along Merchant Coast. Packed with humanoids who drop cloth, silver, and easy kill credits.

name: The Stolen Silver
objective_summary: Recover the Stolen Silver lockbox from a raptor nest in the south.
wowhead_notes: Lockbox sits inside a nest mound near the raptors. You can mount/run past or pull 1 mob, click chest, and leave.

name: In Defense of Far Watch
objective_summary: Kill 10 Razormane Scouts near the eastern border.
wowhead_notes: Scouts are along the road east of Crossroads towards Durotar border. Low health, zero drop RNG, quick clear.

name: Miner's Fortune
objective_summary: Retrieve Cats Eye Emerald from Bael Modan dig site in far south Barrens.
wowhead_notes: Massive travel distance. Located in the extreme southern edge of the Barrens (Bael Modan). Running there on foot at level 16 takes 10+ minutes one-way through level 24+ hostile mobs. Extreme speedrun time sink.
